chunks: From what al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated, from Hammad, from Shu'ayb, from Abi Basir, who said:

I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about ghusl of janabah, so he said: "You pour water over your hands and wash your palms; then you insert your hand and wash your private part; then you rinse your mouth and draw water into your nose; and you pour water over your head three times, wash your face, and let water flow over your body."

key_terms.تَسْتَنْشِقُ: you draw water into the nose
key_terms.تَمَضْمَضُ: you rinse the mouth with water
key_terms.جَسَدِكَ: your body, over which water is made to flow completely
key_terms.رَأْسِكَ: your head, over which water is poured three times
key_terms.غُسْلِ الْجَنَابَةِ: the ritual bath required after the state of janabah
key_terms.فَرْجَكَ: your private part, to be washed before the rest of the bath
key_terms.كَفَّيْكَ: your two palms, which are washed at the beginning

ai.seo_question: How is ghusl al-janabah performed according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the manner of performing ghusl for janabah as taught by Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام. It outlines the practical sequence of washing, making it an important narration in the fiqh of ritual purity and worship.
